core_requests: POL-14 per source (not per module): let a module declaring a large dataset keep an online fallback source, so icij_offshore_api can merge back into icij_offshore (P221 cond 4)
Dataset post-install hook (on_installed) separate from validate, for building derived indexes such as the ICIJ SQLite index (P221)
Dataset licence-decision gate before download (POL-04 for datasets), so the CC BY-NC OpenSanctions bulk can be a registered dataset instead of a manual import CLI (P222)
Engine ordering hints (run_after) so opensanctions runs after the offline sanctions lists (P222)
Allow key blocks in provider extensions, so companies_house_api can merge into the companies_house provider (P227)
Optional organisation-name field in the contact User-Agent template (SEC fair access wording, P223 cond 1)
notes: P221 split into icij_offshore (local ODbL index, disclosure none) and icij_offshore_api (reconcile fallback; explicit selection -M icij_offshore_api + TLP CLEAR/GREEN; steps aside when the local index exists). P222 split into opensanctions (local index from a licence-checked import CLI; no dataset registered because CC BY-NC) and opensanctions_api (key + monthly budget, default 0 = SKIPPED config). Natural-person hits never carry the sanctions tag; companies are 'possible match - confirm identity'. One hop from a seed CNPJ via legal_name/partner_of is the reading of FC1/FC5. sec_edgar needs contact_email (core contact UA); EFTS fixed phrases since 2023-12-18. eu_vies: errors inside HTTP 200 never read as invalid; possible sole traders have name/address dropped and no pivot. uk_companies_house: separate keyed provider companies_house_api; officers/PSC minimised to name/role/dates, pivots expand=False; success fixtures are documented-shape placeholders until team-key captures (P227 cond 6). OpenSanctions /match success fixtures are synthetic (P222 cond 9). Shared helpers: registry_text.py, offline_name_index.py, wikidata_client.py. No LIGHT/ACTIVE variants requested. Registry contract: own modules green; test_notice_fragments_parse fails on cloakquest3r.json (batch p3-G13-1, files not yet created) - not ours.
